{"actions": [], "mode": "answer", "reply": "I cannot fix these issues with the parts listed.

The waist yaw needs 302.4 kg·cm and the waist pitch needs 261.0 kg·cm. The strongest listed replacement for the XL430-W250-T is the DS3218 at 21.5 kg·cm. That is still far below 302.4 kg·cm and 261.0 kg·cm. It would also not meet the 28.8 kg·cm neck yaw or the 26.5 kg·cm upper-arm loads.

The peak current is 27.5 A, while the listed 12 V supply is 5 A and the listed UBEC is 5 A. Neither can supply 27.5 A.

A stronger actuator class and a supply rated above 27.5 A are required. No listed option meets those numbers, so I have made no changes."}
